name: car -body vibration
definition_zh: 铁路车辆车体随运行激励发生的振动响应。

complete_examples.text: The results show that the above methods are visually effective, which can be better used to extract the time -frequency characteristics, confirm the location, and analyze the car -body vibration acceleration dynamic response.

At the same time, for extracting the characteristic frequency (band) which can seriously affect the car -body vibration, correlation analysis between wavelet scale coefficients and car -body vibration acceleration time -history carve was studied.

(a1) 京沪车体垂向加速度功率谱; (a2) 京沪车体水平加速度功率谱; (b1) 沪宁高铁车体垂向加速度功率谱; (b2) 沪宁高铁车体水平加速度功率谱图2 京沪、沪宁高铁车体振动加速度功率谱 ig.2 The car -body vibration acceleration power spectrum of Beijing -Shanghai,Shanghai -Nanjing High -Speed Railway 轨道不平顺与车体振动加速度相干分析研究表明,高低不平顺主要影响车体的沉浮和点头运动,引起车体垂向加速度增大; 轨向不平顺主要影响车体的侧滚和摇头,引起车体横向振动加速度增大,轨道不平顺与车体振动具体关系参考文献[1]。
